passage:
A student used an AI tool to write his history homework. The answer sounded polished, but it included events that never happened.
His teacher noticed and asked him to explain the essay. He could not.
Instead of giving only a punishment, the teacher asked the class to test AI answers. They found that the tool could summarize, suggest ideas, and explain difficult words, but it could also invent facts.
The class created a rule: AI could help with learning, but students had to check facts and write final answers themselves.
The tool was powerful, but it had no responsibility. The responsibility stayed with the student.
